notes: This minor release adds one native Go standard-library pack and extends another. It is built by the same released, checksum-pinned bifrost-semantic-pack 0.15.1 as packs 0.12.0 (public commit 04fdd17d2606d13a7a5f13b012bfbe3ad9729d1e, executable SHA-256 7322cdbd653830aaba349c9a278eceb97573965739b2845412a3074080b6acc2), so it still needs Bifrost 0.15.1 or later, and the bundle keeps release index schema 4 and the same semantic-model read schemas (8, 14, 16, 19, 22). New native pack: bifrost.go.stdlib.database-sql-declarations 1.0.0 (BSD-3-Clause, derived from Go 1.26.0 src/database/sql/sql.go; partial) declares sql.DB, sql.Tx, sql.Stmt and sql.Result and the pointer-receiver Exec methods DB.Exec, Tx.Exec and Stmt.Exec, so calls to them bind to exact declarations with their query and variadic args formals (#224, #225). Like the other Go standard-library packs it activates only on a Go toolchain >=1.26.0, <2.0.0. Changed: bifrost.go.stdlib.net-http-declarations 3.0.0 -> 3.1.0 adds the net/http.Request type and its FormValue method (#225). On Bifrost 0.15.2 both packs activate on a Go 1.26.0 project and these calls bind exactly; call-binding dispatch for the model targets is still reported as partial, so a flow from FormValue to Exec is found as possible, not proven. Source-only, not a native addition: the CodeQL-generated Java JDK summary pack in semantic-packs/jvm/codeql (MIT, derived from github/codeql ae741615f3e178ce61289a651790dc67fcc18e19, generated by the released bifrost-semantic-pack 0.15.2 from Temurin 21+35) (#143). It is not in a release recipe. No pack was removed or renamed and no consumer requirement changed. Rules 0.13.0 keeps its exact dependency on packs 0.12.0; rules 0.14.0 moves it here. Generation, integrity, compatibility and per-run completeness remain separate from behavior qualification.
